main.description: Cover image for a book in the authenticated user's personal library. Serves the cover extracted from the uploaded file when there is one; otherwise, if the book is linked to a BookHive catalog entry, responds 302 to the public image proxy for that entry. The XRPC equivalent of GET /opds/books/{hash}/cover.

width.description: Requested width in pixels for the catalog-cover redirect. Ignored for locally stored covers, which are served at the size they were extracted at.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such book, or the book has neither a stored cover nor a linked catalog entry
